parameters.name: attachResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the attached resource.

parameters.name: attachResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the attachment point supported by the policy.

- HttpApi: HttpApi.
- Operation: Operation of HttpApi.
- GatewayRoute: gateway route.
- GatewayService: gateway service.
- GatewayServicePort: gateway service port.
- Domain: gateway domain name.
- Gateway: gateway.

parameters.name: gatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway instance used to filter results.

parameters.name: gatewayType
parameters.description: The gateway type used to filter results. Valid values: **AI** and **API**.

parameters.name: includeBuiltinAiGateway
parameters.description: Specifies whether the response includes built-in AI plugins installed by the system. Default value: false.

parameters.name: pluginClassId
parameters.description: The ID of the plugin type used to filter results.

parameters.name: pluginClassName
parameters.description: The name of the plugin type used to filter results.

parameters.name: withAttachmentInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether the response includes the plugin attachment information corresponding to attachResourceId.
